---
title: "Personal projects & hobbies"
---

In my free time, you can find me making sourdough bread, taking pictures with my analogue camera, going on walks in the forest, touching moss (yes, that's one of my hobbies) or creating little videos about my life. 
I also love to go running to clear my mind.

Since 2017, I'm doing social media work for the non-profit [Help for a Smile e.V.](https://helpforasmile.de) and I work with the board to further develop the organization.
Help for a Smile makes a real difference for about 20 children and young adults in Uganda by sustainably providing safety and education.
